_about: The Lewydo™ brand standard in numbers — for game code and for Claude. The same as the page https://roshevasternin.github.io/brand/ (rules, live previews). Take the pictures and the code as they are; never redraw the mark. Sizes are dp (the design size, 360×800 screens); the PNGs are @3x of them.
name: Lewydo
sloganNote: Always in English — a trademark. Its bold letters (L, e, W, Y, Do) spell the name: Lewydo.

repo.note: If the web is blocked in a sandbox, clone the repo: the kit is in brand/kit/, this file is brand/brand.json.

font.name: Nunito Black 54.17 / 74, white, shadow 0 4.17 2.08 rgba(0,0,0,.25)
font.slogan: Nunito 13.54 / 19: L, e, W, Y, Do — Black, the rest Regular
font.note: In apps the name and the slogan are pictures (lewydo.png, slogan.png): no font needed for the mark.

brand_back.what: The glow — fills the 208×208 logo box, under the heart

brand_front.what: The heart — 140×140 in the middle of the logo box

lewydo.what: The name «Lewydo» (Nunito Black, white, soft shadow)

slogan.what: The slogan «Love What You Do» — never translated

brand_line.what: The line under the slogan, 20 below it

lockup.what: The whole Lockup in one picture — for places without code (stores, videos, slides)

signature.what: The Signature: the logo 24 + the name

pill.what: The Signature pill of a menu, with its capsule and ›

atlas.note: LibGDX TextureAtlas of the five pictures (@3x). assets/atlas/brand.atlas + brand.png → your assetsBrand (EnumAtlas.BRAND).

lockup.stack: vertical, centred: logo, name, slogan; the line 20 below the slogan

signature.note: The Lockup's logo and name, small: nothing else.

pill.place: the bottom of every game menu, centred, 34 from the bottom

splash.first: The first screen of every Lewydo game
splash.theme: The background and the ambient light may follow the game. The Lockup, its numbers and its timeline never change.

heartbeat.never: in a loop (no Actions.forever, no infinite)

id.title: Tentang kami
id.text: Lewydo adalah studio game indie dua orang dari Ukraina. Vlad menulis kode, Lilya mendesain. Bersama, kami membuat game yang kami sendiri suka mainkan. Terima kasih sudah bermain!

de.title: Über uns
de.text: Lewydo ist ein Indie-Studio aus der Ukraine – wir sind zu zweit. Vlad programmiert, Lilya gestaltet. Zusammen machen wir die Spiele, die wir selbst gern spielen. Danke fürs Spielen!

en.title: About us
en.text: Lewydo is a two-person indie game studio from Ukraine. Vlad codes, Lilya designs. Together we make the games we love to play. Thank you for playing!

es.title: Sobre nosotros
es.text: Lewydo es un estudio indie de dos personas de Ucrania. Vlad programa, Lilya diseña. Juntos hacemos los juegos a los que nos encanta jugar. ¡Gracias por jugar!

fr.title: À propos
fr.text: Lewydo est un studio de jeux indépendant de deux personnes, en Ukraine. Vlad code, Lilya fait le design. Ensemble, nous créons les jeux auxquels nous adorons jouer. Merci de jouer !

it.title: Chi siamo
it.text: Lewydo è uno studio indie di due persone dall’Ucraina. Vlad programma, Lilya disegna. Insieme creiamo i giochi a cui amiamo giocare. Grazie di giocare!
it.games: I nostri giochi su Google Play

nl.title: Over ons
nl.text: Lewydo is een indiegamestudio van twee mensen uit Oekraïne. Vlad programmeert, Lilya ontwerpt. Samen maken we de games die we zelf graag spelen. Bedankt voor het spelen!

pl.title: O nas
pl.text: Lewydo to dwuosobowe niezależne studio gier z Ukrainy. Vlad programuje, Lilya projektuje. Razem robimy gry, w które sami uwielbiamy grać. Dziękujemy, że grasz!

pt.title: Sobre nós
pt.text: Lewydo é um estúdio indie de duas pessoas da Ucrânia. Vlad programa, Lilya faz o design. Juntos fazemos os jogos que adoramos jogar. Obrigado por jogar!

vi.title: Về chúng tôi
vi.text: Lewydo là studio game indie hai người đến từ Ukraina. Vlad viết code, Lilya thiết kế. Cùng nhau, chúng tôi làm những trò chơi mà chính mình yêu thích. Cảm ơn bạn đã chơi!
vi.games: Game của chúng tôi trên Google Play

tr.title: Hakkımızda
tr.text: Lewydo, Ukrayna’dan iki kişilik bağımsız bir oyun stüdyosu. Vlad kodluyor, Lilya tasarlıyor. Birlikte oynamayı sevdiğimiz oyunları yapıyoruz. Oynadığın için teşekkürler!

uk.title: Про нас
uk.text: Lewydo — інді-студія з двох людей з України. Влад пише код, Ліля робить дизайн. Разом ми робимо ігри, у які самі любимо грати. Дякуємо, що граєте!

ko.title: 소개
ko.text: Lewydo는 우크라이나의 2인 인디 게임 스튜디오예요. Vlad는 코드를, Lilya는 디자인을 맡아요. 우리가 즐겨 하는 게임을 함께 만들어요. 플레이해 주셔서 고마워요!

ja.title: 私たちについて
ja.text: Lewydo はウクライナの2人組インディーゲームスタジオです。Vlad がコードを書き、Lilya がデザインを担当。自分たちが大好きなゲームを一緒に作っています。遊んでくれてありがとう！
ja.games: Google Play の私たちのゲーム

zh-TW.title: 關於我們
zh-TW.text: Lewydo 是來自烏克蘭的兩人獨立遊戲工作室。Vlad 寫程式，Lilya 負責設計。我們一起做自己愛玩的遊戲。謝謝你的遊玩！
zh-TW.games: 我們在 Google Play 的遊戲

do: Use the pictures and the code of the kit as they are.
Keep the colours, the font and the proportions.
Let the heart beat once when the brand appears.
Theme the background and the ambient light to your game.
Keep the mark on a dark background.
dont: Redraw, recolour, stretch, squash, rotate or add effects to the mark.
Translate the slogan or set the name in another font.
Put the mark on a light or busy background.
